text:
sara: Heads-up — noticed a broken internal shortlink in the Runtime Onboarding runbook (docs/runtime/onboarding.md). The link pointing to /models/quantization returns 404 in staging. Anyone owning that doc?

jihoon: I can grab it. Can you paste the exact anchor or the curl output? :+1:

sara: here's the quick check i ran:
```
curl -I https://staging.redwood.ai/models/quantization
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```
Anchor in the doc: `#int8-practices` — link looks like `/models/quantize#int8-practices` in the runbook.

matt: sounds like a slug rename. Quick local fix is: `sed -i 's#/models/quantize#/models/quantization#g' docs/runtime/onboarding.md`
I'll review a PR but probably better to add a redirect if external links exist.

sara: i'll open a tiny PR — also going to tweak the copy a bit: change "we recommend int8" -> "we recommend 8-bit quantization (int8)" for clarity.
Can @lisa handle localization queue for ja/es once it lands?

lisa: yep, ping me when the PR merges. our i18n bot will auto-pick up changed files; add label `i18n:force` if you want expedited translation.

david: fyi earlier docs CI showed: `broken-link-checker: 1 broken links` in staging run. If PR only updates the anchor it should clear, but keep an eye on the staging deploy tests.

sara: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — tiny sed + copy tweak. @matt can you review? cc @jihoon

matt: i'll take a look shortly. One thought: if /models/quantize was removed (and used externally) we should add a redirect in _redirects (or netlify config) to avoid future 404s.

jihoon: :thumbsup: checked model-catalog history — old slug `/models/quantize` was removed 2025-11-02 during the model-catalog rename. I'll add a `_redirects` entry under `site/static/_redirects` in the infra-docs repo and include it in the PR if folks want.

oncall-bot: staging deploy scheduled at 12:30 UTC — will run after PR merge.

sara: thanks all — assigning ownership for the route to @jihoon. i'll wait for @matt review then merge and queue localization.
